name: Public File Service Health Check
description: Read-only nightly health check of the Drive→GCS sync pipeline behind the public file service: sync-service is up, the Drive watch is active (renew if expired), and GCS is fresh. Reports HEALTHY/DEGRADED/FAILED.
narrative: A read-only nightly check that the public-file pipeline is healthy end to end. Confirm the sync service is up and serving, that the Drive→GCS watch is registered and not expired (renew it if it lapsed — that renewal is the one allowed action), and that the storage bucket is fresh and consistent with the Drive source. Close with a clear HEALTHY / DEGRADED / FAILED verdict and the evidence for it. Everything but a watch renewal is read-only: a problem is a finding to surface, not something to fix here.
